description: This Java source file defines the class TokenComparison, which represents a token used for comparison operations in expressions. It extends the Token class, encapsulating comparison operators such as ==, !=, >, etc., and provides methods to access the comparison type and evaluate characteristics of the token.

classes.name: TokenComparison
classes.description: A specialized Token class that models comparison operations within expression parsing, including equality, inequality, greater than, less than, and their variants.

methods.name: getComparison
methods.description: Returns the comparison operator enum value associated with this token.

methods.name: isComparison
methods.description: Indicates that this token represents a comparison operation, returning true.

methods.name: isNegateComparison
methods.description: Returns true if the comparison token is a negation (i.e., 'not' comparison).
